change.text: The charge is still rare and rarely lands. Bots should charge an open line several times a minute each, and the charge should bowl over everyone within a step of its line, not only the man straight in front, throwing each one higher than his own head before he lands. Braces are so rare I never see BRACED!: a rival who sees a charge coming at him should turn his raised shield to it most of the time, and the rest step aside.
